name: Kau
source:
Meet an unknown girl in the street. She is a runaway. Lure her to an abandoned building, capture her, confine her, tear off her clothes. Her only garment is her collar, and she is yours to raise as your pet.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031514.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在街上遇到一个陌生的女孩。她是一个离家出走的人。把她引诱到废弃建筑里，抓住她，囚禁她，撕掉她的衣服。她唯一的衣物就是项圈，而她就是你饲养的宠物。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031514.html]DLsite English[/url]]
